scene: The flowers sneeze glitter, revealing a bustling transit depot.
picture: Pixel art flat side view of a rooftop transit hub. On the far left, a candy-striped steam train sits on tracks. In the centre, the South Asian girl in her teal hoodie and purple wheelchair is dusted with sparkling pollen. To her right idles a yellow delivery truck. A glowing glass elevator waits far right.
shown: a candy-striped steam train puffing sweet vapor on the far left
a yellow robotic delivery truck idling with its back doors open on the right
a transparent elevator shaft glowing soft blue on the far right
